turns.question: Which channel's cost per booking rose the most from the week of 14 September 2026 to the week of 21 September, and by how many euros?
turns.answer: Social's cost per booking rose the most, by 27.00 EUR (from 98.00 EUR in the week of 14 September 2026 to 125.00 EUR in the week of 21 September 2026; search fell about 3.13 EUR and email stayed at 70.00 EUR). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
